mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_employee ( shop_id, username, password, avatar_url) VALUES (#{shopId},#{username},#{password},#{avatarUrl});
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_employee SET last_login_time = datetime('now', 'localtime'), login_count = COALESCE(login_count, 0) + 1, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
